status.label: Handled by linked PR
status.detail: The Quick Accent stuck-overlay issue is longstanding and now has an active upstream PR, so it is not a 0.101 release regression to design separately.

next_action.label: Monitor linked PR
next_action.reason: Track PR #50212 and avoid duplicate dashboard design work.

judgment.rationale: This issue predates 0.101 and is already covered by active PR #50212 for the focus-loss stuck-toolbar path.
evidence: Original report was filed for PowerToys 0.79.0 and later commenters describe longstanding timing/focus-loss behavior.
Recent analysis says the toolbar is hidden only when the held letter key-up reaches KeyboardListener::OnKeyUp, leaving it orphaned if that key-up is missed.
PR #50212 is open for Quick Accent and its commit message says it closes #31988.
The PR changes KeyboardListener.cpp and KeyboardListener.h to hide the toolbar on EVENT_SYSTEM_FOREGROUND when focus leaves.
judgment.recommended_action: Track upstream PR #50212; no separate design/action.

issue_context.summary: Quick Accent can remain stuck on screen after fast typing, gaming, RDP, or focus loss; a contributor supplied a proposed native keyboard-service fix and opened a PR.
known_information: The original issue version is 0.79.0, so it is not a 0.101 introduction.
Multiple users reported stuck overlay behavior and workarounds such as triggering another accent.
Recent comments separate focus-loss and timing/race entry points.
PR #50212, "[PowerAccent] Hide stuck accent toolbar when focus leaves the window", is open.
inferences: The active PR likely covers the focus-loss subset but may not fully address same-window timing races described by some commenters.
The 0.101 mention is from contributor validation that the native-layer patch applies to both WPF 0.100 and WinUI 0.101, not a release-regression report.
issue_context.analysis: Because there is an active PR touching the exact native keyboard listener path, the dashboard should mark the issue as handled elsewhere rather than start a duplicate design.
initial_investigation: PR #50212 diff adds SetWinEventHook(EVENT_SYSTEM_FOREGROUND) and resets m_toolbarVisible before calling m_hideToolbarCb(InputType::None).
Timeline shows numerous related Quick Accent stuck-overlay duplicates, including #32225, #35972, #38915, #44482, and open #32047.
